reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer:
A waɗi booddum no ngadduda ɓingel ma asibiti wakkati majjum, ngam boosaaru ndu heɓaay allura waawi raabugo ɓingel man nyaw bone (rabies) caka barme nde'e. 

Kuje artunde nde min mbadata jotta, min lootay barme man bee ndiyam doggojam e saabunde ko heewi ngam min mbara daɗi nyaw man. 

Baawo majjum, min kookay ɓingel man allura nyaw boosaaru (rabies vaccine) bee allura ndedegel (tetanus) ngam hisnugo yonki maako dow nyawji kalluɗi ɗin. 

Ngam barme man ɓuuti hollay mbutu nasti, ngam maajum min kookay mo lekki karginoojum (antibiotics) e lekki naawalla ngam o heɓa jam barme man ndaana. 

Taa wujju koo ɗume e barme man seyy ko minon likito'en mbaɗata, nden mbi'a joomi boosaaru ndun ɓe paka ndu balɗe sappo ngam min ndaara hallende nyaw man.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Ɓoyre satunde, walaa naawalla nder enndu debbo, waaway laatago nyawu pamaru bana tana (fibroadenoma) koo boo nyawu ladde enndu (kansa). Ngam ɓoyre nden ɗon saati boo ɗon sali dillugo, o waɗi daadaa ngam o yehi larugo likitaajo laara daliila maajum. Nder asibitiiji amin, min ɗon waɗa sikaan (ultrasound) koo min ƴetta kusel pamarel (biopsy) ngam min laara koo kansa on waddi ɗum. Daliila waddata ɗum ɗon ƴiwoy diga tagdi ɓandu (hormones) koo iwdi asuli, ammaa faamugo law ɗon hisna yonki debbo. Vi'i mo taa o humtu, ammaa o tokka umroore likitaajo haa koondey ngam o heɓa lekki caahiiki.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira
reference:
Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer:
Nyawu nguu naawi, ngam tuure e doggu-reedu lebbi fof ina addana bingel lo'eende masin e nattude semmbe. 

Ngam reedu ndun lo'i, taa fudu e nyaamdu teddundu; arandu hokka mo ndiyam lamdam e sukkar (ORS) bee kunuuru ndu hawtiraa e nebbam, biiri, koo murgu-soya ngam o heba semmbe. 

Dalila woni, reedu ndun foti heba nyaamdu ndu sahtaani nyaameede seede-seede, ngam taa o tuuta fahin, haa teteki din ndammba heba laamu. 

To asibiti, minen ndarata koo o hokka nyaamdu asibiti (Plumpy'Nut) e lekki mboondi (Zinc) ngam darta doggu-reedu ndun. 

Yaawnu yahru mo asibiti bako semmbe makko timma pat, ngam likita en mbaawa wadugo gwaji nden mballa mo diggasam.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer:
Sannu ma, alamaji ɓingel ma ɗo holla ngel ɗon dami be nyawu 'Pneumonia' (siiwa) ko asma nawɗum, laarugo no ɓernde mako nastata lukka, o fofata be sembe, kadi o wawataa nyamugo. 

Ɗum masibo cattuɗo, ngam maajum taa ɗaɓɓu nyamdu ko lekki kemist haa saare, baawo hosi ɓingel ngel yaara asibiti manga jotta-jotta. 

Haa asibiti, likit'en mballan mo be henɗu (oxygen) heɓa o foofa boɗɗum, kadi ɓe fiyan mo botiiji ngam mbara kuyeji dasata nyawu man. 

Lekki ɗojjugo ki keɓuda haa kemist wala ko nafata ngam ɓufu-ɓufu (lungs) mako ɗon cukkii sossai. 

Useni taa haku be nyamdu wakkati ɗo, yawo yaru mo asibiti kadi kakkilana ɗawrol likita, ɗum on hisnata yonki mako.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Ƴowru Subeeru ndu waɗi lebbi tati bee saɗugo foofugo ɗon holla alamaaji nyawu tiiɗuɗum bana firohi (Tuberculosis) malla nyawu poppe (Asthma/COPD), ɗum lekki leɗɗe, njuumri malla goro kaati waawataa yamɗintingo. Aada men haa asibitiiji, koo ndeye ƴowru salti asaweeje ɗiɗi, sey to goɗɗo waɗi teesti tuutuɗe (sputum test) bee hooto ganjogol (Chest X-ray) ngam anndugo ngilngu hallungu wonngu e poppe. Hanndi Subeeru lorta asibiti lawlaw o ƴama likita'en ɓe waɗana mo teesti firohi (TB), ngam lekki maggi laamu ɗon hokka ɗum meere kadi ɗum ɗon yamɗintina nyawu ngu'u faat to ɗum jaɓaama booɗɗum. O acca hudoore lekki leɗɗe bee shawariiji yimɓe gariiri ɗi nafataa, o jaɓa safaara likita'en bee hucaaku ngam poppe makko laaɓa. To o tokki laawol safaara asibiti ngol, o heɓan o foofa booɗɗum no haanndi, kadi ɓanndu makko lortan jam.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer:
Sannu ma dada, ndaa amsa am dow nyawu e shawara haa debbo danyiɗo e ɓingel maako:

1. Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗam ɓawo danyngo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɗon wara ngam reedu (uterus) pooɗaaki faa wooɗi bawo danyngo, heddoode sawaye (placenta) nder reedu, koo bo tayki ɓandu wakkati danyngo. 
2. Nder sibiti, min mbaddan mo ndiyam lekki (drip) e buraare (bana *Oxytocin* koo *Misoprostol*) ngam reedu pooɗa iyam may dara, min laɓɓina nder reedu maako to woodi ko heddi nder fow. 
3. Ngam o lorna sembe maako, e hoore iyam rufi sosai, o yidi ɓe tura mo iyam (blood transfusion), ɓe hokka mo leɗɗe ɓeydooje iyam, e nyaamdu ndu woodi nafu bana teewu e haako (vegetables). 
4. Shawara am haa dada may, o tokka musnugo ɓingel may kosam endi maako wakkati fuu, ngam musnugo ɗon walla reedu pooɗa (contract) iyam bo dara. 
5. O faddina ɓingel ngulɗum, o ɓamta laaɓal wuro e bandu maɓɓe, kadi o jooɗa nder sibiti haa likitajo wi'a o heɓi jam kanko e ɓingel fuu kamin ɓe lora wuro.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Alamoji ɗi a limti bana nawol hoore tsariindi, daande tiiɗugo, hulugo annoora (hite), e peppetel ɓandu ɗon nufa nyawu nguleendi mboɗeeri je ɓi'eteeɗum 'Meningitis' (Sankara koo Pabbuwa), nguu laatoto nyawu masiibo raɓotoongu sosai. Kaanje kuroori (bacteria) naatata nder ndiyam ngaandi waddata ɗum, nden ɗum raɓoto nder weeyo to goɗɗo ɗojji koo ilni haa nokkuuje jama'aare, bana no ɗum heewi waɗugo nder lesdi Naajeeriya wakkati cheeɗu. Ngam tabbitingo nyawu ngu taa on ngada tijjoore, laabi on waɗa gwodi teetugo ndiyam ɓawo (Lumbar Puncture) e asibiti heɓa ɓe laara nder kakkal (lab) ngam anndugo irin kuroori maajum. Ngam ɗum haala gaggabo ndi waawata warugo neɗɗo, nyawɗo o foti heɓugo leɗɗe injeeshin ɗe sembe bana 'Ceftriaxone' lawlaw, nden o foti haseego feere mako taa o raɓa woɓɓe. reference:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
model_answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi, bana ɗojju fajira e bone foofugo ɓaawo yaaɓugo seɗɗa, ɗon holla nyawu mboobo mangou (bana asma, furee/TB, koo lakkugo curki) koo bo nyawu rafi sembe ɓernde (heart failure). 

Ee, nyawu mboobo e ɓernde ɗon njokka laawol gootol; to mboobo nyawi masin wawan lakkugo ɓernde, nden bo to ɓernde luttiri turaago ƴiiƴam ɗum wawan waddugo ndiyam nder mboobo haɗa foofugo ngam sembe. 

Ko ɓurnata waddato bone foofugo e somugo lau kanjum on yaraago taba, curki yiite kuka, raɓɓooji gaaɓare (pneumonia), e nyawuuji ɓernde. 

Alaamaaji maseeɓe ɗi bandiraaɓe handi laara ngam doggugo asibiti lawlaw kanjum on: naawalla gaaɓare, foofugo e iidaango mbura, ɓawluki koo saayuki tonndu, koo to nyawɗo waawaa wolwugo kalimaaji faari ngam tampiri foofɗe. 

Debbo o numi numo boodɗo masin ngam o woyani asibiti; likita'en ɗon haandi waɗana gorko man hoto gaaɓare (Chest X-ray) e awugo ɓernde (ECG) ngam anndugo gonga nyawu man e hokkugo safaara celluka.

model_answer: Alamaji ɗi on mbati hollingo, bana gite e bandu waɗugo oolo, zazzabi mangu, la'ifu, e hoore naawugo, ɗon holla nyawu mangu bana pabbooje (Severe Malaria) koo boo nyawu hanta (Hepatitis koo Yellow fever). Alaamaji ɓingel ngel, bana salugo musinugo, walaa sembe, be ɓandu fewugo delem, ɗon holla nyawu mbuuɓri cattuɗum (neonatal sepsis) ɗon nder ƴiiƴam maagel.

Shawara am lawlaw, daada waɗa ɓingel ngel e ɓandu muɗum haa gaba (Kangaroo Mother Care) ngam ngel wula, nden on nawa ngel haa likita'en ɓikkon keccon lawlaw taa ngel maaya. 

Ɓingel ngel ɗon haaji kwantugo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam heɓugo leɗɗe *antibiotics* e ndiyam suukar nder ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) ngam mbarmugo nyawu ngun e hisnugo yonki maagel.

model_answer: Anniya dada ɓingel wargo sibiti lawlaw woni kuugal ngal ɓuri wooɗugo, ngam naawalla kosteji e juɗe haa ɓingel lewru jowi ɗon holla alaama nyawu 'sickle cell' malla nyawu mboowu (infection) nder i'e mako. To on wari sibiti, likita'en mbatta tefoore ƴii'yam (genotype e FBC) ngam anndugo asali nyawu ngun, heɓa ɓe hokka mo maganiiji ɗi ke'ata mo. To o heɓi kulle e magani law, naawalla man daran, ɓandu mako fukka jam, nden o tokka mawnugo bana no ɓiɓɓe godɗi fuu mawnota.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai

model_answer: Alaamaaji ɗi ɓingel holli, bana ɗojjugo jemma e saɗugo fofugo, ɗon holla nyawu Asima (Asthma) ɗon dammi mo, naa nyawu ɓernde. Alaamaji ɗi a limti ɗo, bana yarugo ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam, sillugo akai-akai, lo'ugo ɓandu, e wumre gite, ɗi ɗon holla alamaaji nyawu suga (diabetes) nangi gorko ma. 

Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu ɗon tefa wurtinki suga ɗuuɗɗum nder ƴiiƴam ta laawol silleeji, ɗum hokka mo ɗonka ndiyam, nden sootaaki suga ngam heɓugo sembe waddata soomaye ɓandu mako e matsala gite. 

Yaru mo asibiti wuro mon lawlaw ngam likita en ƴeewa suga ƴiiƴam mako saa'i o suumii (Fasting Blood Sugar) e ɓamtuki ƴiiƴam (Blood Pressure) ngam tabbitingo nyawu nguu e hokkugo mo safaare de heedata. 

Daga jooni, o acca yarugo kuujeji mari suga koo ndiyam leemuuji mbilaaɗi, o ustita nyaamduuji tedduɗi bano nyiiri, o ɓesda nyaamugo haakooji e tokkugo yarugo ndiyam laaɓɗam ngam ɓandu mako heɓa ndiyam. 

Awnugo suga ƴiiƴam e sappoondirgo bee likita handi waɗee akai-akai no likitaajo umri, ngam a lura e laamu ɓandu mako e faddaago naawallaaji goɗɗi.

question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina

Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗi kaalɗaa, bana tampugo wakkati musinugo, wulinago haa hoore e yeeso, e fofaango tiiɗungo, ɗum alamaji hattaraaji hollooje ɓingel ngel danyi nyawu ɓernde (congenital heart disease) koo nyawu pampamje (pneumonia) nawngu. Ɓingel ɗon wulina, ɗon tampa wakkati musugo ngam musinugo ɗum kuugal teddungal haa ɓikkon; to ɓernde koo pampamje walaa sembe, ɗi mbaawataa lilaago ƴiiƴam e henndu (oxygen) heƴoowu haa ɓanndu. question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai

Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer:
Ndaa no min waɗata ngam hisnugo yonki debbo oo e darnugo ƴiiƴam rufata dow anndal likitanci:

1. Daande arande, min pikkante mo *cannula* ɗiɗi maapindiiji min caama mo leebura ndiyam (drip) *Normal Saline* malla *Ringer's Lactate* ngam hisnugo yonki maako dow ƴiiƴam ɗam rufi haro o sakli ɗon (shock). 
2. Min ƴettan ƴiiƴam maako ngam laarugo asali maajum (blood group) ngam min ɓeyda mo ƴiiƴam lawlaw, kadi min waɗa gwaji reedu (PT) ngam tabbitingo koo reedu on rufata.
3. Lekkiiji min hokkata mo ngam darnugo ƴiiƴam kanji on batte *Tranexamic acid* bee *Misoprostol* malla batte *Oxytocin* ngam ɓiɗɗugo saaldu (uterus) tawee e lekki naawalla.
4. Min waɗante mo hoto reedu (*ultrasound scan*) lawlaw ngam min laara koo reedu rufi haa nder (incomplete abortion) koo bo reedu fesi haa goriiji (ruptured ectopic pregnancy).
5. Baawo *scan* mai, min waɗante mo woggo-reedu (MVA/Evacuation) to reedu rufi, malla seekugo reedu (laparotomy) lawlaw to reedu on fesi haa yaasi saaldu ngam darnugo rufugo ƴiiƴam mai sak.

model_answer: Oɗo debbo reeduujo ɗo mari nyawu ƴawoore ƴiiƴam mawndi nder reedu (Severe Preeclampsia), ngam hoore naawande, ɓuutol ɓandu, be gite daurɗe ɗe o yi'ata. Magani nyawu ngun timmi ko rimmbugo cukkayel ngel, ngam maajum likito'en haani ɓe kakkilana mo sosaay koo ɓe seeka mo (CS) to wakkati rimmbugo yottake ngam hisnugo mo be ɓingel ngel. model_answer: Canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel laato ɓaleejum ɗon holla ronkugo hendu poofirgal (oxygen) nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum bo waaway laatugo nyawu ɓernde (congenital heart defect) malla nyawu nduufa mawngu (pneumonia), naa ɗum alhaali koondey. model_answer: Alamaji ɗi debbo redujo ɗo holli, bana fiyal ɓernde lawlaw, somo, diwugo juɗe, be uppugo yeeso daande, ɗon holla nyawu nguuɗi daande (Hyperthyroidism), wato ɓesdaari ndiyam *thyroid* nder ɓandu ɗam ɓurti heddo. question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tarihi cattuɗi, fofugo lau, be salugo musnugo ɗo holla alamu nyawu gidaaɗo nawɗum bana 'pneumonia' ko bo fuɗɗoode fuka (asthma) haa keccel. Nyawu man ɗo ɓura nyadugo jemma gam jaangol, ko bo curki wuro (bana leɗɗe defugo ko tapozi) be kura ɗon omba laawol heendu ɓingel, ɗum waɗa o fofa be bone. Angal heendu laɓɓundu ɗon haɗa keccel man ɗana woka jemma, kadi ɗum wawan waɗugo hasare mawnde ngam ɓingel ɗon maaya heendu. Taa hokka ɓingel lekki tarihi wuro; likita asibiti wawan hokkugo mo lekki mbarmu (antibiotics) to ko 'pneumonia', ko lekki ombitirki gidaaɗo to ko fuka waɗi mo. Gam hisnugo ɓingel ma, sora mo nguleeka jemma, woɗɗin mo diga curki, nden a tefa kowale kala o musna gam o heɓa ndiyam be sembe.

reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. model_answer:
Bismilla, ɓingel ngel foti yahgo asibiti lawlaw ngam lekki gargajiya e taygo ɓe waɗi ɗon waddani mo mbuuɗu e namputure (infection) haa fiyaande nden.

To rawandu ngati neɗɗo, ko ɓuri faida woni wuuwugo babal ngal bee ndiyam ɗon dogga e koo wande sabunde fuffu (bana sabunde wakkude koo laski) ngam mbarugo nyawu.

Watugo lekki gargajiya bana 'aforo' ɗon ɓesda bone, nden ɗum wawan waddango ɓingel ngel nyawu mangungol ngol saakata ɓandu maako fuu to ɓe yawtai asibiti.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Nyawu ngu ɓingel ngel heɓi noddirtee "febrile convulsion" (dimbugo ngam pampammi zazzabi), ɗum ɓuri waddugo ɗum ko zazzabi pabboje (malaria) nyawndu malla mboowu (infection) nder ɓandu maagel. Hakkulngo aranndeego wakkati jonɗo man, waalo ɓingel ngel dow gafakkal (watawal) maagel ngam taa ngel looha, nden taa saawu layɓu malla junngo nder hunduko maagel. question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
Sannu ma, rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo har juɗe e kosɗe fewa, ɓandu soma ɗum alama holloore iyam ɗuɗɗum saali ma (Postpartum Hemorrhage). 

Mi laaɓinan bo mi laara baabel danyugo ngam mi ɓenna koo heddande ɓaawel (placenta) don nder dimru malla ɓandu seeki, ngam kanjum ɓuri waddude rufugo iyam ɗam. 

Mi winndan ma lekki kiɗon ɗarna iyam rufata bee wallude dimru famɗita e hoota nokkuure maari (bana Oxytocin malla Misoprostol). 

Ngam lornuki sembe ma e ɓesdugo iyam nder ɓandu ngam a waawa hakkilgo bee ɓingel ma, a heɓan ndiyam caahu (IV fluids) malla a ɓesde ƴiiƴam to haaji waɗi, bee lekki ɓesdata iyam (iron supplements). 

Barka ma ɓingel ma na ɗon jam bana a yi'i, jooni ɗum wakkati nyawndugo ma ngam a heɓa sembe nde a hakkilinta be mako booɗɗum.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Fofugo lawlaw (dakkere) bee dojjooru wakkati-wakkati nder ɓikkoi pettoi, ɓurna fuu nyawu mboombu (pneumonia) koo nyawu pallande foofugo waddata ɗum. Nyawuuji ɗi ɗon ɓilla goriiru foofugo ɓingel, ɗum haɗa hendu naatugo daidai, waɗa ɓingel fofa bee tiiɗaaku. Kooti koo mbutu-mbutu (virus) waddata nyawu nguu, na yiwgo ɓingel bee ndiyam peewɗam bana no yimɓe tammi ba. Kuje nde a waɗata lawlaw woni a yaara ɓingel asibiti ngam likita'en caanca, ɓe hokka lekki (antibiotics) koo hendu (oxygen) to dagi. Taa hokka lekki dojjooru koo safaare leɗɗe haa wuro; tiiɗa-foofugo woni alama nyawu nawnungu ngu waawi taya yonki ɓingel to a yaaraayi asibiti lawlaw.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Ko waddi ɗum ɗo woni rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum ɓuri waddigo koo raaɗu (uterus) debbo famfataako warta no waanunoo, taygo nder farji, koo bo tummude ɓingel (placenta) heddi nder, ammaa famɗi ko laata ɓingel goɗngel heddi nder reedu. 

Lawlaw njoggoɗon reedu maako on muusa e sembe (uterine massage) ngam raaɗu nduu pooɗa kanta iyam man, kadi pachee mo ruwa drip (IV fluids) lawlaw ngam taa o waasa sembe maako. 

On mbaawan waɗugo mo bati (injection) je Oxytocin nder i'al koo bo on hokka mo lekki Misoprostol ngam ɗum walla darngo iyam man. 

Ndaaree boo e laaɓal to o taayii on ɲoota, koo bo to heddere tummude ɓingel heddi nder reedu on itta ɗum. 

To iyam man sali darugo lawlaw bawo on waɗi ɗum ɗo fuu, nulee mo asibiti manga (refer) bee wakkati ngam likito'en ɓedda wallugo mo taa o sooya yonki maako.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Kine ɓingel ma sukki, kadi ɓikkon keccol kine ɓe foofirta, kanjum waɗi to o nangii enɗam sai o acca law ngam o heɓa o foofa. Ngam wallugo mo, toɓɓa ndiyam lamɗam ceewɗam (saline drops) ko pette enɗam ma seɗɗa nder kine mako ngam damba man ɓoosa, ɓawo don goggu kine man laɓɓina heɓa o foofa o musina boɗɗum. Tokku findinugo mo e rokkugo mo enɗam wakkati fuu ngam taa o waasa sembe nder ɓanndu. Amma to a laɓɓini kine man bee maajum o waawaa musugo, ko a yi'i oɗon foofa e jaawngal, ko ɓanndu mako wuli, yaru mo asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara mo.

Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer:
Taa accitu debbo on hoota saare be lekki dojjere tan, ngam poofde ta'oore e gabaare loppotoonde ɗon holla ɓingel ngel wondi be nyawu pofɗe cattuɗum (*severe pneumonia*). 

Sey a nasta ɓingel ngel asibiti (admit) ɗon e ɗon, a lornana ngel poofde (*oxygen*) to haaje waɗi, bo a fuddana ngel pije (*IV antibiotics*) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel. 

Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi jeego'o lekki leɗɗe malla lekki dojjere ceeɓaaki haa kanti walaa nafuura, kadi ma ɗum ɗon hallina nyawu man sosai. 

Aanaa a waɗa bincike/ndaarndaaki bano hooto gabaare (*chest X-ray*) e ndaarugo ƴiiƴam ngam a tabbatina asali nyawu man hiddeko a timmina harka lekki. 

Haa asibitiiji gure meɗen, sey a famtina daada'en taa ɓe nyawnda ɓikkon haa saare be leɗɗe, sey ɓe wadda asibiti lawlaw to dojjere fuɗɗi ngam taa tura yotta ɗo.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer: Titilola, alamaaji ɗi caftiɗaa bana ɓandu wulndu, diwngo, e dande tiiɗnde (walaa waawugo wailitugo) ɗon holla ɓingel maada ɗon mari nyawu ngaandi e ƴiƴal ɓaawo bi'eteengu "Meningitis" ngu heewi haa leydi meeɗen. Ko haɗata ɓingel wailitugo dande e waddata zazzaɓi (fever) ngun kanjum woni ɓuutugo ɓokkooji deenooje ngaandi maako, nden boo nyawu nguun kallaangu masin, ngu ɗon waawi nawnugo gite koo mbara neɗɗo. Diga jooni, wattu ɓingel ngel haa asibiti mawndo (General Hospital) lawlaw, taa faɓɓu koo huutore safaara leɗɗe wuro. Haa asibiti, likita'en mbaɗan ndaargal ƴattugo ndiyam ɓaawo (Lumbar Puncture) e ndaargal ƴiiƴam ngam anndugo tigi-tigi ko waddi nyawu ngun, bee ndaargal jontere (Malaria) ngam heɓugo safaara feewndaare. Yaawnu yahrude mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita'en puɗɗa barmugo mo bee bakkale e leɗɗe ngam kisndam yonki maako.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗi ɓingel ma waddi, bana dojjere jamma, ta'ol pofɗe, bee iido nder ɓerde, ɗo holla alama nyawu asma (asthma) ko bo pewol ɓerde mangol (pneumonia). Kuje kalluɗe ɗe fotti a hakkila bee mum kanjum woni to o ɗo fofa bee sembe fa ɓerde mako ɗo loha nder (chest indrawing), ko to o waawataa nyamugo e wolwugo. Ngam ustugo dojjere nden, fotti a reena ɓingel man diga kura, pewol, curki yiite ko fiya-fiya mbuuɓu, e urdiji ghaɗuɗi, ngam ɗum ɗo ɓilla ginaaji pofɗe mako. Nder jamma jotta, wallin mo o tikkira dow e fowru ngam pofɗe mako ɓurta, kadi ɓorna mo kare nguleeki ngam reena mo pewol. Yahu asibiti law jaango fajjiri ngam likita'en mbecca mo, ɓe hokko mo maganiiji maɓɓitooji pofɗe ngam o heɓa laafiya.

Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer: Ɗum alamaaji dojju rabeeru (whooping cough), nyawu ngu kootuuji (bacteria) ngaddata nder poofirɗe ɓingel, waɗa dojju naawngu haa fofugo saɗa ngel sosai. Ha asibiti, likita'en ɗon mbaɗa awo ƴiiƴam (blood test) bee ƴeewndo ndiyam daande ngam anndugo tigi-tigi irin kootu waddi nyawu ngun. Safaara maajum kanko laati hokkugo lekki mbaroohi kootuuji (antibiotics) bana *Azithromycin*, hawtaade bee ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ngam taa ɓanndu ɓingel njoora. Shawara am to renowo on, kanko yaara ɓingel asibiti lawlaw ngam ɓingel ɗon haaji wallinde oksijin (oxygen) wakkati ngel fofata daker. question: nonnon tan min laari debbo reduje je sibiti amin wari fajiri ɗo o wari be nauɗum sosai o ɗo hoka be sembe o ɗo jogi ɓawo mako be redu mako ngam nonɗum o nanata ɓawo minti jetati yahugo sappo haa nder sudu dayugo min waddi mo min laari mo min tawi ɓingel ɗo jippa pellel dayugo ɗi neeɓai sam o dayi ɓingel debbo to min waddi ni ko haandi fu en waɗata ɓawo redujo dayi neeɓai ni min hoosi dada be ɓingel maako min jari ɓe har suudu ɓe siwtata de neeɓi seɗɗa sai dada mai yoni amin o yoni amin o yecci amin o ɗo nana o wala sembe o nana o somi gite maako o yi'ata laɓɗum o wi'a amin o godi nyamugo ɓaawo o danyi amma daker o heɓi o nyami be yiri may wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta o ɗo dana o wala sembe be o fuɗɗi nanugo gilol ɗime on fe'i bannin ko yi'am vurti ha maako sosai o wala yi'am o handi ni ka ko o handi ni kaɓilungo yi'am ko ɗume wadanta mo min hokka mo yi'am naa ko min hokka mo nyiri

Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.

model_answer: Alaamaaji ɗi debbo on holli, bana waasugo sembe, niɓɓugo gite, be nanugo jaangol/gilol, ɗon holla o waɗi asarar ƴii'yam masin ɓaawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum lunciti mo haa darnde delmugo ɓandu cika (hypovolemic shock). Taa hokku mo nyiiri wakkati on ngam ɗum wallataa mo bo o waaway tuutugo; ko o haandi o heɓa lawlaw kanci on ɓilgo mo ƴii'yam kese be ndiyam tiimbol (IV fluids) ngam yonki maako heɓtita. Baakin ɗon, a haandi a tefa ko addani mo rufugo ƴii'yam majjum law, heɓa a ɓiɗɗa/nyobba reedu maako (uterine massage) be hokkugo mo bargoohi oxytocin, bee laargo to ngayka danygol seeki ngam a nyoota ƴii'yam majjum daro. E nder gite anndal am haa asibitiiji Afirka, asarar ƴii'yam ɓaawo danygol on ɓuri warugo rewɓe reduuɓe law, ngam maajum wurtungo mo ƴii'yam on woni magani hisnata mo, naa hokkugo mo nyiiri.
